headline: Mass spectrometry methods for PTM-resolved and isotope-labeled protein analysis
label: Clinical Proteomics Biomarker Profiling
summary: New tools extend mass spectrometry to single-cell histone PTM quantitation, open modification searching and isotope-resolved metabolite identification.
synthesis: The common thread is methodological refinement of mass spectrometry workflows for quantifying and identifying biomolecules with greater specificity. A targeted TMT-multiplexed SureQuant triggered MS/MS strategy with super heavy TMT triggers quantifies histone H3 post-translational modifications in single cells. ANN-SoLo, an enhanced spectral library search engine, integrates Prosit-predicted libraries, spectrum-level and peptide-level decoys, and complementary ion vectors to improve open modification searching. MIMI, a command-line tool, identifies metabolites in UHR-FT-ICR data by matching peaks to theoretical isotopic variants of stable isotope-labeled species. These items are analytical rather than clinical and do not share a disease context. What is new is the combination of predicted spectral libraries, modification-resolved single-cell quantitation and isotope-variant matching for high-resolution data analysis.
